select_sql: SELECT h.hk_customer AS customer_hk, h.customer_key, s.customer_name, s.email, s.phone, bv.full_address, s.city, s.state_province, s.postal_code, s.country_code, s.customer_segment, bv.customer_type, bv.tenure_band, bv.is_contactable, s.customer_since, s.is_deleted, s.load_date AS valid_from, coalesce(s.load_end_date, timestamp'9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS valid_to, s.is_current, s.record_source FROM {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.hub_customer h JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.sat_customer s ON s.hk_customer = h.hk_customer LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.business_vault.sat_customer_bv bv ON bv.hk_customer = h.hk_customer AND s.load_date >= bv.load_date AND s.load_date < coalesce(bv.load_end_date, timestamp'9999-12-31 23:59:59')

SELECT h.hk_product AS product_hk, h.product_key, s.product_name, s.product_category, s.product_subcategory, s.brand, s.unit_cost, s.unit_price, cast(s.unit_price - s.unit_cost AS decimal(18,4)) AS unit_margin, s.is_discontinued, s.is_deleted, s.load_date AS valid_from, coalesce(s.load_end_date, timestamp'9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS valid_to, s.is_current, s.record_source FROM {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.hub_product h JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.sat_product s ON s.hk_product = h.hk_product

SELECT h.hk_employee AS employee_hk, h.employee_key, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.job_title, s.office_city, s.hire_date, s.is_deleted, s.load_date AS valid_from, coalesce(s.load_end_date, timestamp'9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS valid_to, s.is_current, s.record_source FROM {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.hub_employee h JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.sat_employee s ON s.hk_employee = h.hk_employee

SELECT lop.hk_order_product AS sales_line_hk, lop.hk_order AS order_hk, lop.hk_product AS product_hk, loc.hk_customer AS customer_hk, loe.hk_employee AS employee_hk, ho.order_key, lop.order_line_number, so.order_date, cast(date_format(so.order_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS order_date_key, so.order_status, so.currency_code, sol.quantity, sol.unit_price, sol.discount_amount, bv.gross_amount, bv.net_amount_calc AS net_amount, bv.discount_rate, bv.lead_time_days, bv.is_cancelled, sol.ship_date, sol.delivery_date, cast(date_format(sol.ship_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS ship_date_key, cast(date_format(sol.delivery_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS delivery_date_key, sol.load_date AS valid_from, coalesce(sol.load_end_date, timestamp'9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS valid_to, sol.is_current, sol.record_source FROM {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.lnk_order_product lop JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.hub_order ho ON ho.hk_order = lop.hk_order JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.sat_order_line sol ON sol.hk_order_product = lop.hk_order_product LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.business_vault.sat_order_line_bv bv ON bv.hk_order_product = lop.hk_order_product AND bv.is_current LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.sat_order so ON so.hk_order = lop.hk_order AND so.is_current LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.lnk_order_customer loc ON loc.hk_order = lop.hk_order LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.lnk_order_employee loe ON loe.hk_order = lop.hk_order

SELECT lrop.hk_return_order_product AS return_line_hk, lrop.hk_return AS return_hk, lrop.hk_order AS order_hk, lrop.hk_product AS product_hk, loc.hk_customer AS customer_hk, lre.hk_employee AS employee_hk, hr.return_key, ho.order_key, lrop.order_line_number, sr.return_date, cast(date_format(sr.return_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS return_date_key, sr.return_status, sr.return_reason_code, sr.return_quantity, sr.refund_amount, sr.currency_code, sr.load_date AS valid_from, coalesce(sr.load_end_date, timestamp'9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS valid_to, sr.is_current, sr.record_source FROM {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.lnk_return_order_product lrop JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.hub_return hr ON hr.hk_return = lrop.hk_return JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.hub_order ho ON ho.hk_order = lrop.hk_order JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.sat_return sr ON sr.hk_return_order_product = lrop.hk_return_order_product LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.lnk_order_customer loc ON loc.hk_order = lrop.hk_order LEFT JOIN {vault_catalog}.raw_vault.lnk_return_employee lre ON lre.hk_return = lrop.hk_return

SELECT customer_hk, customer_key, customer_name, email, phone, full_address, city, state_province, postal_code, country_code, customer_segment, customer_type, tenure_band, is_contactable, customer_since, valid_from AS last_changed_at FROM {gold_catalog}.historical.dim_customer_hist WHERE is_current AND NOT is_deleted

SELECT product_hk, product_key, product_name, product_category, product_subcategory, brand, unit_cost, unit_price, unit_margin, is_discontinued, valid_from AS last_changed_at FROM {gold_catalog}.historical.dim_product_hist WHERE is_current AND NOT is_deleted

SELECT employee_hk, employee_key, first_name, last_name, job_title, office_city, hire_date, valid_from AS last_changed_at FROM {gold_catalog}.historical.dim_employee_hist WHERE is_current AND NOT is_deleted

SELECT cast(date_format(calendar_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS date_key, calendar_date, year(calendar_date) AS calendar_year, quarter(calendar_date) AS calendar_quarter, month(calendar_date) AS month_number, date_format(calendar_date, 'MMMM') AS month_name, weekofyear(calendar_date) AS week_number, dayofmonth(calendar_date) AS day_of_month, dayofweek(calendar_date) AS day_of_week, date_format(calendar_date, 'EEEE') AS day_name, dayofweek(calendar_date) IN (1, 7) AS is_weekend FROM (SELECT explode(sequence(date'2020-01-01', date'2030-12-31', interval 1 day)) AS calendar_date)

SELECT sales_line_hk, order_hk, product_hk, customer_hk, employee_hk, order_key, order_line_number, order_date, order_date_key, order_status, currency_code, quantity, unit_price, discount_amount, gross_amount, net_amount, discount_rate, lead_time_days, is_cancelled, ship_date, delivery_date, ship_date_key, delivery_date_key FROM {gold_catalog}.historical.fct_sales_hist WHERE is_current AND NOT coalesce(is_cancelled, false)

SELECT return_line_hk, return_hk, order_hk, product_hk, customer_hk, employee_hk, return_key, order_key, order_line_number, return_date, return_date_key, return_status, return_reason_code, return_quantity, refund_amount, currency_code FROM {gold_catalog}.historical.fct_returns_hist WHERE is_current
